biggest_catch: You earn only if buyers order — there are zero guaranteed jobs — and Fiverr keeps 20% of every order (including tips) while holding your earnings for a 14-day clearance period before you can withdraw.
catches: Zero guaranteed jobs or income: you set gig prices, but buyers must choose you; competition is intense and new sellers get little visibility.
Fiverr takes a flat 20% commission on every order, including tips — a $100 order credits you $80.
Earnings are locked for a 14-day safety clearance period after order completion (7 days only for Top Rated Sellers) before they become available for withdrawal.

Withdrawal methods carry their own fees/processing times: PayPal, bank transfer via Payoneer, Payoneer account, and Fiverr Revenue Card (new Revenue Cards can no longer be created; existing users may keep theirs).

Buyers also pay a 5.5% service fee plus a $3.50 small-order fee on orders under $200 (per Fiverr's Payment Terms, last updated January 2026), which inflates your gig's real price and pushes buyers toward cheaper sellers.
Orders can be cancelled or disputed by buyers; funds are held until disputes resolve. Low starting prices mean very low effective hourly rates.
Identity verification may be required before withdrawing; Fiverr pays in USD, so currency conversion fees may apply.

steps: Create a free Fiverr seller account at fiverr.com and complete your profile (skills, portfolio, photo).
Create gigs describing exactly what you'll deliver, with a starting price you set yourself — remember Fiverr keeps 20%, so a $50 gig pays you $40.
Win orders by responding fast and delivering quality work; buyers must accept the delivery (or it auto-completes) for earnings to post.
Wait out the 14-day clearance period after each completed order (7 days once you reach Top Rated Seller status).
Go to Selling > Earnings, verify your identity if asked, and link a withdrawal method (PayPal, bank transfer via Payoneer, or Payoneer account).
Withdraw cleared earnings (minimums and per-method fees apply); expect 1-3 business days for PayPal, 3-7 for bank transfer.
Reinvest in reviews and gig quality — without orders there is no payout, so treat the first gigs as reputation-building.
timing: Earnings become available for withdrawal 14 days after an order is marked complete (7 days for Top Rated Sellers). Withdrawals: 1-3 business days via PayPal, 3-5+ via bank transfer/Payoneer.
